name: @poe-code/task-list-rust
description: Rust task state machines and identity validation with no npm runtime dependencies

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-host.mjs && node ../mcp-protocol-rust/scripts/cargo.mjs build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/prepare-host.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node ../mcp-protocol-rust/scripts/cargo.mjs test && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project tsconfig.types.json && cd ../.. && vitest run --config packages/task-list-rust/vitest.reference.config.mjs
